name: temper
description: Claude cannot write code before you approve the intent. Gated plan, TDD, review and check for AI written code, with a phase bar in Claude Code.

uiMode.title: Temper UI mode
uiMode.description: How much Temper draws: full, minimal or off. The gate questions, the denials and the subcommands are the same in every mode.

enforcement.title: Temper enforcement
enforcement.description: on refuses writes outside the stage, --no-verify, a changed hooks path, and a step only the person may take without their answer; off keeps the drawing only. Values: on or off.

prAttribution.title: Pull request attribution
prAttribution.description: on adds one Temper line to Claude Code's attribution text for pull requests. Values: on or off.

phaseModels.title: Per-phase models
phaseModels.description: Optional. Comma separated phase=model pairs such as build=sonnet. Empty means no change.

reviewerModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewerModel.description: Optional model for the Temper review agent. Empty means no change.
